name: Gyro Palace #3
address: 8814-B Route 9 South, Unit 12 (behind the car wash), Northgate Crossing Shoppes, Exit 27
about: Gyro Palace was opened in 1998 on Route 9 by my father. That building is a phone store now. This is the third one and it is the only one still open, same recipes, same white sauce, my brother Emre runs the grill six days. We do not use a commissary and we never have.
announcement: WE ARE OPEN. The app says 45 minutes but on Friday it is closer to an hour, we have one grill. If you need it faster please call the store direct at (555) 018-4471 and ask for Sami, do not put it in the notes because the printer cuts them off. Sorry for the incovenience.

promos.text: $2 OFF IF YOU ORDER ON THE PHONE INSTEAD

reviews.name: Denise Okafor
reviews.text: I have been ordering the chicken over rice from these guys for nine years, first when they were on Route 9 and now here behind the car wash. The portion is still big enough that I eat it twice and the white sauce is still made in the back and not bought. Sami remembers that I don't want onions and he has never once gotten it wrong. The only thing I will say is the app charges you to not have rice, which Sami told me is not his doing.

reviews.name: M. Trevino
reviews.text: There is nowhere to park. The car wash people yell at you. Food was excellent.

reviews.name: Anthony R.
reviews.text: Ordered the mixed grill for four people and it fed six. Lamb chops were pink in the middle like I asked.

reviews.name: Priya S.
reviews.text: I called three times and nobody picked up. Then I walked in and there were two people working and both of them were on the grill, so I understand now.

reviews.name: Big Ray
reviews.text: The hot sauce warning on the menu is not a joke and I want everyone to know that I respect them for putting it in writing.

reviews.name: Carolyn W.
reviews.text: This is not the Greek place with the blue awning by the highway. That one closed. I keep ordering here by mistake and it is better anyway, but I am leaving one star for the confusion.
